short_description:
The GTA 6 Ninja Turtles easter egg: a storm drain just north of Millport, by Lake Tallaloko and the Tallaloko Dam (guides differ on the exact spot: the strip between the town and the lake, or the dam's pumping station). Go at night: green ooze seeps through a crack in the concrete under a staircase, with four tiny turtles, pizza boxes and a rat nearby. Rockstar hasn't confirmed it, and the game never says the name. No story spoilers.

📍 Map Spot #7 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Sources: VGTimes, Middle East Gamer, Complex, GTA Culture, EGW.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).

short_es.description:
El easter egg de las Tortugas Ninja en GTA 6: un desagüe al norte de Millport, junto a Lake Tallaloko y la presa (las guías difieren en el punto exacto). Ve de noche: baba verde bajo una escalera, cuatro tortuguitas, cajas de pizza y una rata. Rockstar no lo ha confirmado. Fuentes: VGTimes, Middle East Gamer, Complex.
